title: Atiefo a Wɔahintaw a Wogye dii
intro: Wɔ nhyiam kronkron bi mu kommyɛ mu no, nhyiam bi a ɛyɛ nwonwa fi ahemman bi a wonhu mu bae. Esiane sɛ na biribi a ɛyɛ nwonwa ho nsɛm a wɔka no asereserew twee wɔn nti, wotiee nsɛm a wɔkae a ɛbɛsɔ wɔn nkrabea agyirae daa. Wɔn adansedie da so ara yɛ soronko paa wɔ ɔsoro kyerɛwsɛm mu no mu baako.
clues: Yɛyɛ abɔde a yefi ahemman bi a dodow no ara nhu, na yɛbaa sɛ kuw.
Yɛtuu kwan kɔɔ nhyiamu bi sɛ yɛrekɔte biribi a ɛyɛ nwonwa.
Bere a yeduu hɔ no, yetiee akenkan bi a ɛmaa yɛn ho dwiriw yɛn.
Yegye toom pefee sɛ yɛn mu binom yɛ treneefo na ebinom nso nyɛ trenee.
Na yenim sɛ yɛrentumi nkwati ɔsoro ahyɛde a ɛwɔ asase so no, na saa ara nso na yɛrentumi nguan nkɔ wim.
Bere a yɛtee akwankyerɛ no, yegye dii; obiara a ogye wan Awurade di no rensuro adehwere anaa adesoa.

verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
